scope: One Instruments seed, original six tasks and930 LC-Rec SID,4epochs/global128, sampled SeqRec validation,24772 users times17 prompts beam20; no formal run launched

full_workload.layout_method: Four fixed NumPy permutations of every original-realization row, padded with unchanged repeated original indices to observed sampler presentation count; paired-rank MAX per microstep
full_workload.boundary: Exact full token/label distribution and sampler counts; random padding layout is a deterministic cost scenario, not the saved actual rank sampler hash

nonnegative_forward_backward_fit.method: Nonnegative least squares by all seven active subsets; elapsed-time predictor, not FLOPs or a confidence interval

training.timing_denominator: Two synchronized ranks, MAX rank wall; never sum rank wall seconds
training.other_cost: Whole update wall minus its slow-rank F+B includes collator, transfer, optimizer, synchronization, guard and probe instrumentation exactly once
training.communication: ZeRO communication inside measured backward/step is included; separate NCCL kernel time is not profiled
training.conservative_method: Maximum NNLS/residual/constant/linear/quadratic full-distribution sensitivity plus worst steady non-F+B overhead, multiplied by1.25

test.formula: Sum over17 prompts of24772/2 * mean_or_max(actual per-user beam20 generation seconds)
test.processing_proxy: Template MAX-rank wall minus actual assigned critical-rank generation sum, divided by its two real cases; includes callback construction, collator, decoding, original evaluator sort and barriers. Original callback reuse can make formal processing cheaper; no speedup assumed
test.remaining_unknown: Full-test result aggregation/durable output flush and trained-output variation are unmeasured and covered only by explicit planning reserves

checkpoint.state_static_formula: 2*physical_unique_parameters +12*trainable_parameters: BF16 model plus global FP32 master and Adam moments; metadata/layout/storage sharing can differ
checkpoint.missing: Full training-state I/O has no successful real donor; never substitute adapter-only save or zero

initialization.boundary: Five/ten minute planning allowances, not measurements. Full formal CPU preparation and new-process recovery are not executed. Counting one cold update again is deliberate initialization reserve

Q06-L.selection_rule: Latest timestamped attempt with both rank reports; no fastest-attempt selection; prior failures retained

training_definition.loss_aggregation: Original LC-Rec shifted-token mean per rank microbatch, divided by accumulation and averaged across ranks by ZeRO-2

formal_loader.dataset_wrapper: Length-only wrapper; no raw record is loaded or trained during sampler inspection

long_tail_evidence.communication: Real ZeRO-2 hooks, gradient reduction/accumulation and complete AdamW boundary update

micro_loss_weighting.meaning: Actual original rank/micro CE averaging changes task and token weighting with micro layout even at global128; different selected micro layouts are not identical optimization trajectories
micro_loss_weighting.formal_epoch_tail_numerical_equivalence: NOT TESTED by the full-global128 bounded updates

reserves.conservative: 1.25 factor within measured component scenarios, plus10% subtotal and30min operating reserve
